ja.label: Suno
ja.title: 「Higher Than the Night」が256再生増
ja.summary: 9月30日から10月4日に、公開45曲は計657再生・7いいね増え、65,894再生・395いいねに。「Higher Than the Night」はこの期間で最も再生が増え、14,853再生となりました。新曲の追加はありません。

en.label: Suno
en.title: Higher Than the Night gains 256 plays
en.summary: From September 30 to October 4, the 45 public songs gained 657 plays and seven likes, reaching 65,894 plays and 395 likes. Higher Than the Night had the largest play increase, reaching 14,853 plays. No new songs were added.
